hazards.title: Unprotected edge at floor opening
hazards.description: The large opening into the lower level in the center foreground has a wooden guardrail only along its far side, leaving the near concrete edge fully unprotected next to the walkway.
hazards.category: Working at Heights and Fall Protection

hazards.title: Uncapped vertical rebar
hazards.description: A row of protruding vertical rebar dowels without impalement caps runs along the left walkway where a worker is walking, creating an impalement hazard if someone trips or falls onto them.

hazards.title: Damaged wooden stair treads
hazards.description: The temporary wooden stairway on the right has broken, splintered and missing tread sections that could give way or cause a fall.

hazards.title: Makeshift guardrail without toeboard
hazards.description: The wooden guardrail at the opening's far side appears improvised with no toeboard, allowing tools or debris to fall into the lower level.

hazards.title: Trip hazard on rebar mats
hazards.description: Workers in the mid-ground are walking and working directly on open rebar grids, creating a risk of trips and falls onto the steel.

hazards.title: Awkward bent-over rebar tying
hazards.description: Workers in the mid-ground are bent over at the waist tying rebar at ground level, posing repetitive back strain risk.

hazards.title: Loose debris along walkway
hazards.description: Broken concrete, rubble and loose material lie along the base of the rebar line beside the left walkway.
